assessments.name: Samoa
assessments.assessment: WGSRPD level-3 Samoa geographic/botanical grouping; five full members include four American Samoa units and independent atlas territory WSM. Census/statutory district sources support subdivisions but do not define this area as political administration. Retain membership as reviewed reference; semantic approval remains open.
assessments.source_lineage: WGSRPD level 3 geographic area; source calls these botanical countries

assessments.name: Tokelau Archipelago
assessments.assessment: Tokelau-Manihiki geographic grouping includes Swains Island, Tokelau coverage NZL-5472 and one wider macro-coverage location. Natural Earth region_sub Tokelau is a cartographic grouping attribute; ASCA says Swains administration is directly under the American Samoa Governor. These facts do not settle or contradict geographic membership. No shared boundary changes; request coordinated neighboring review before any footprint correction.
assessments.source_lineage: WGSRPD level 3 geographic area; source calls these botanical countries

assessments.name: Wallis and Futuna Islands
assessments.assessment: Wallis & Futuna Islands geographic grouping contains the three official circonscriptions Uvéa, Alo and Sigave; customary and statistical subunits match the grouping role. INSEE/Assembly evidence is not legal land boundary evidence; source-derived membership is not regional approval.
